title: Рабочая гипотеза: стабилизация единицы сегмента до объектного совмещения TCAFF
fixed_before: Variant construction and every TCAFF run of this protocol. The FastSAM frontend run on all frames was already started; it records mask attributes only and does not depend on the variant rules below.
motivation: Segmentation audit on 800 sampled frames (results/segment_unit/sample_audit.json): among box-related segments in the authors' detection set 32% cover several GT boxes, 31% of visible boxes appear in two or more saved segments, and the segment unit of a box changes between consecutive sampled frames in 23% of cases. Multi-layer depth flags 33% of merged segments and 5% of single-box segments.
hypothesis: In this scene a large part of wrong or lost object correspondences comes from an unstable segment unit (part/whole, nested masks, masks spanning several depth layers). Removing container masks and multi-layer masks before mapping lowers the alignment error of the unchanged TCAFF pipeline without a material loss of availability, compared with the same frontend without these rules.
tcaff_parameters: configs/release.yaml, unchanged; only fastsam3d_data.root differs per variant

frontend.fastsam_package: CASIA FastSAM commit 4d153e9, ultralytics 8.0.120, PyTorch 2.4.1 CPU
frontend.measurement: TCAFF FastSAM3D: pixel mean and covariance of the mask; centroid = mean pixel back-projected at the median valid depth (raw depth >= 1 mm); width/height = pixel bounding box at that depth; masks without valid depth dropped
frontend.frames: Every frame of the saved author JSON (13546 frames, four robots); L515 colour and aligned depth with the same stamp

R0.rule: TCAFF measurement + drop masks touching the image border (the audit indicates the authors applied this filter)

U1.rule: R0 minus container masks: a mask is removed when at least 80% of the area of another R0 mask lies inside it (computed at 1/4 resolution)

U2.rule: R0 minus multi-layer masks: at least 10% of valid depth pixels lie more than 0.30 m behind the median depth, or at least 10% lie more than 0.30 m in front of it (same definition as the audit)

U3.rule: R0 minus masks removed by U1 or U2

B0.rule: Authors' saved detections; frozen release baseline (results/baseline/audit.json); different frontend run, not the controlled comparison

thresholds_origin: 80% containment, 0.30 m layer and 10% share were used in the 800-frame audit before this protocol; they are not tuned on any TCAFF result.
repeat_note: CLIPPER uses std::random_device; repeats are independent runs, not paired seeds

metrics.primary: share of all pair updates with an estimate within 1 m and 5 degrees of GT (unavailable updates count as not correct)
secondary: mean of per-directed-pair mean translation and yaw error (released demo metric)
availability = accepted pair updates / all pair updates
first acceptance time per directed pair
mechanism: share of box-related detections covering two or more GT boxes
share of (frame, GT box) observations present in two or more detections

decision_rule: Supported if, averaged over repeats, U3 has a higher primary metric and a lower mean-of-pair-means translation error than R0, both differences exceed the range of R0 across its repeats, availability falls by at most 5 percentage points, and the mechanism metric (multi-box share) decreases. Otherwise not supported; U1 and U2 are reported as ablations without changing the verdict.
independence: One recording. The audit that motivated the rules used 800 frames of the same recording; this is a test of a fixed rule on the full recording, not an evaluation on unseen data.
excluded: changes to TCAFF costs, size gate, CLIPPER or temporal filter
retuning thresholds after seeing TCAFF results
